name: Stride
subtitle: Experimental Android compatibility runtime for iPhone.
description: Stride is an experimental iOS project focused on running Android apps and games through a native translation layer. Compatibility is under active development; app inspection does not guarantee that an APK will launch. No public Stride IPA release is listed yet.

apps.name: Stride
apps.subtitle: Experimental Android apps and games on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Stride is an experimental iOS runtime focused on Android APK compatibility through a native translation layer. Development areas include DEX execution, Android framework APIs, JNI and Bionic compatibility, native library loading, graphics translation, audio and input. Compatibility is not guaranteed: an app is only confirmed working after it launches and renders on a real device. The current project build is not yet published as an installable IPA.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Stride uses the local network to pair with this iPhone for JIT, without a computer.
